content.text: Fix confirmed working. Cleaning up the temp check file.

The regression was a missing `not` in `TokenList.token_first`'s matcher in `sqlparse/sql.py`. It was returning the first whitespace/comment token instead of skipping past them, so `get_type()` and other code relying on `token_first` saw the wrong token (e.g., whitespace) and fell through to `'UNKNOWN'`. Restored the `not` and verified `get_type()` now correctly returns `SELECT` in plain, leading-whitespace, and leading-comment cases.
